title: LSP4IJ Erlang Language Platform (ELP) settings JSON schema
description: JSON schema for the settings of the Erlang Language Platform (ELP), which it reads from the elp section.

elp.diagnostics.disabled.description: List of ELP diagnostics to disable.

elp.diagnostics.enableExperimental.description: Whether to show experimental ELP diagnostics that might have more false positives than usual.

elp.diagnostics.enableOtp.description: Whether to report diagnostics for OTP files.

elp.diagnostics.onSave.enable.description: Update native diagnostics only when the file is saved.

elp.highlightDisabledCode.enable.description: Whether to highlight disabled code branches.

elp.highlightDynamic.enable.description: If enabled, highlight variables with type `dynamic()` when Eqwalizer results are available.

elp.hoverActions.docLinks.enable.description: Whether to show Hover Actions of type `docs`. Only applies when `elp.hoverActions.enable` is set.

elp.inlayHints.parameterHints.enable.description: Whether to show function parameter name inlay hints at the call site.

elp.lens.buck2.mode.description: The buck2 mode to use for running tests via the code lenses.

elp.lens.debug.enable.description: Whether to show the `Debug` lenses. Only applies when `elp.lens.enable` is set.

elp.lens.enable.description: Whether to show Code Lenses in Erlang files.

elp.lens.links.enable.description: Whether to show the `Link` lenses. Only applies when `elp.lens.enable` is set.

elp.lens.logview.links.description: Whether to enable LogView lens links.

elp.lens.run.coverage.enable.description: Display code coverage information when running tests via the Code Lenses. Only applies when `elp.lens.enable` and `elp.lens.run.enable` are set.

elp.lens.run.enable.description: Whether to show the `Run` lenses. Only applies when `elp.lens.enable` is set.

elp.lens.run.interactive.enable.description: Whether to show the `Run Interactive` lenses. Only applies when `elp.lens.enable` is set.

elp.lens.scuba.links.description: Whether to enable Scuba lens links.

elp.lens.wam.links.description: Whether to enable WAM lens links.

elp.log.description: Configure LSP-based logging using env_logger syntax.

elp.typesOnHover.enable.description: Display types when hovering over expressions.
